run_gfl_detection: run the GFL object detection model with ResNet50 backbone on COCO dataset using mmdetection
train_gfl_model: train the Generalized Focal Loss detector with ResNet50 FPN on COCO using 1x schedule
configure_gfl_head: configure the GFLHead with QualityFocalLoss DistributionFocalLoss and GIoULoss for 80 COCO classes
setup_resnet_backbone: setup a ResNet50 backbone with pretrained torchvision weights and batch normalization for feature extraction
tune_optimizer: tune the SGD optimizer with learning rate 0.01 momentum 0.9 and weight decay 0.0001
